title: An Automated Website Audit and Lead Pipeline
subtitle: Turning bad website scores into a qualified outreach list, automatically
blurb: Built a Make.com automation for Webhecho, a US-based marketing agency, that audits prospects' websites via Google PageSpeed Insights, generates an AI before/after redesign comparison, scores leads, and routes qualified prospects into cold email outreach.
result: Automated the pipeline from site audit to outreach-ready lead

meta.solutions: Workflow Automation, AI Image Generation, Lead Qualification

whoFor: A marketing agency needing a scalable way to identify businesses with outdated or underperforming websites and turn them into outreach-ready leads without manual auditing.
challengeIntro: Finding and qualifying prospects for website redesign services meant manually checking sites one at a time, with no consistent way to demonstrate the improvement a redesign could offer before ever contacting the business.
challengePoints: No automated way to audit prospect websites at scale
No visual way to show a prospect what an improved version of their site could look like before outreach
No scoring system to separate strong leads from weak ones
Outreach was disconnected from the audit and scoring process
builtIntro: A multi-step Make.com scenario that runs a full audit-to-outreach pipeline on autopilot.
builtPoints: Google Drive storage for audit assets
Instantly integration for automated cold email outreach
Separate mobile-friendliness detection scenario using viewport-tag regex matching, in place of an additional PageSpeed API call
builtOutro: Each qualifying lead moves from raw website scan to a scored, outreach-ready prospect with its own AI-generated before/after visual, without manual review at any step.
